detailed_notes.backend_verification: Ran test_core_live_session_products.py - all 71 tests PASS covering: (A) platform/account_name bugfix in Reviews & Returns - POST without account_id returns 400, wrong platform/account_name corrected from master, PUT doesn't overwrite platform; (B1-B5) Live session products CRUD - create session with products[], validation rules enforced (duplicate products, wrong catalog, revenue>0 with units_sold=0, over-allocation all rejected), update/delete/sync-totals working, list returns products_detail, analytics returns real data with correct filtering; (C) Import - source type registered, context options work, CSV auto-mapping without AI, SKU validation, commit validation, rollback working; (D) Cascade delete working.
detailed_notes.frontend_verification: Verified core features via Playwright: (1) Live Sessions table shows 18 sessions with Rincian Produk column displaying product details; (2) 18 Package icon buttons present with correct data-testid pattern; (3) Product Details Dialog opens successfully showing 3 products with all fields (SKU, units, revenue, orders, price); (4) Reconciliation bar displays correctly ('227 unit · Rp 14.931.950', 65% coverage); (5) All key buttons present (Tambah produk, Simpan rincian, Samakan total sesi, delete row buttons). Session timeout prevented full verification of Analytics tab navigation, Import wizard flow, and Create Session form, but core integration between backend and frontend is confirmed working.
detailed_notes.gate_verification: Ran bash scripts/gate.sh - all 21 checks PASS including INV-MKTSCOPE which specifically tests marketing scope + import without AI (MKS-24..27 are new checks for product details per live session). No regressions detected.
detailed_notes.known_data: Test environment has 3 demo store accounts (Shopee Official Store DEMO, Shopee Reseller A, TikTok Shop DEMO), each with 6 catalog items, 18 live sessions with product details (50 lines total from seed). Backend test created and cleaned up 2 test sessions successfully.
